# Workspace Guidance

This workspace is Opus & Octavo, a React + TypeScript + Vite document builder.

- Keep form inputs visibly labeled, keyboard accessible, and uniquely named.
- Render authored content as semantic document markup, not as a screenshot or canvas.
- Preserve responsive editor and preview layouts, strong contrast, and visible focus styles.
- Keep print output to US half-letter pages (5.5 × 8.5 in, printed two per letter sheet), hide editor controls, and avoid splitting headings from their content where practical.
- Do not claim ADA or WCAG certification. Generated content and final print/PDF output still require review and testing.
- Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint` after meaningful changes.

## Setup Checklist

- [x] Verify workspace instructions exist.
- [x] Clarify the project requirements: React, TypeScript, Vite, accessible document editor.
- [x] Scaffold the project in the workspace root.
- [x] Customize the editor, live preview, responsive layout, and print view.
- [x] No additional VS Code extensions are required.
- [x] Compile and lint the project successfully.
- [x] Run the local development server for browser verification.
- [x] Document setup and accessibility scope in the README.
- [x] No custom VS Code task is needed; npm scripts cover build, lint, and development.
